Course datasets used in lectures, homework, and solutions.

## Available data

- [Q-matrix](q_matrix.csv) — item-to-attribute mapping used in the DINA Bayesian explorer.

## Required datasets

The homework and some lectures reference the following files from the `data/` directory. Add them here to enable the data-dependent exercises.

| File | Used in |
|------|---------|
| `diabetes_data.csv` | Introduction to Statistics, Sampling, Numeric Summaries, Data Visualization, Bayes' Theorem, Conditional Probability |
| `cs_dataset.csv` | Numeric Summaries, Data Visualization, Conditional Probability |
| `failure_time.csv` | Numeric Summaries, Data Visualization |
| `study_hours.csv` | Simple Linear Regression |
| `housing.csv` | Simple Linear Regression |

## Data privacy

Student response data and gradebook files are **not** published with this site. They are stored locally in `private/student_data/` and excluded from version control.
